entities.summary: Reggio Emilia Cathedral is a Roman Catholic cathedral in Reggio Emilia. The dedication is to the Assumption of the Virgin Mary. Formerly the episcopal seat of the Diocese of Reggio Emilia, it has been since 1986 that of the Diocese of Reggio Emilia-Guastalla.
